summary: Web search, page fetch and site crawl through one Tavily instance. Every operation is a read sent as a POST; each spends the instance's Tavily credits, so each carries the money consequence. Results are third-party web content and are untrusted.

websearch.search.name: search
websearch.search.summary: Search the web for one query; each result is a website with its URL, title, description and, on request, its content.
websearch.search.guidance: max_results is required (1 to 20). content is snippet unless asked: none drops it, full asks for the page text. complete is false and truncation names the cause when fewer results came back than asked, the answer passed 3 MiB or a content was cut at 128 KiB.

websearch.fetch.name: fetch
websearch.fetch.summary: Fetch the text of one or more pages by URL; each URL answers a page or a failure.
websearch.fetch.guidance: complete is true when every URL answered, as a page or under failed. A page's content is cut at 128 KiB and the answer at 3 MiB; truncation names either cut.

websearch.crawl.name: crawl
websearch.crawl.summary: Crawl a site from one URL, up to limit pages, and answer the text of each page reached.
websearch.crawl.guidance: limit bounds the pages; complete is false with result_limit when the crawl reached it. max_depth and max_breadth narrow the walk; select_paths and exclude_paths are regular expressions over the URL path.
